content.short: An NFT animation project from Jesse Moynihan | Adventure Time & Midnight Gospel.
content.description:
Jesus 2 is a dark comedy about twin brothers in space trying to destroy the sick, black magic reincarnation of God. The proceeds from the collection will go towards funding a 7 minute animated short film.

The film will be produced by an animation team who have worked on high profile projects such as Rick and Morty, Midnight Gospel, Adventure Time, and Eastbound and Down.

Creator Jesse Moynihan designed 30 unique characters from the world of Jesus 2, with a total 6,666 variants to be divided into three mints.
